dashboard.yourCodeHint: Give this to a project host, or to a neighbour who wants to invite you.
dashboard.needSecondReading_one: {{count}} plot needs a second soil reading before carbon change can be measured.
dashboard.needSecondReading_other: {{count}} plots need a second soil reading before carbon change can be measured.

step.drawWhy: Mark the boundary on the map. Your area is measured from the outline, so there is nothing to type.
step.cardWhy: Copy the organic carbon and pH from the card you already have. This gives your plot a starting point.
step.secondWhy: Carbon credits are paid on change, so a second card from a later date is what turns your first into a baseline.
step.joinWhy: Projects group many farmers so verification is paid once for everyone instead of once each.

parcels.title: My plots
parcels.instruction: Tap each corner of your field. The shape closes itself once you have three.
parcels.measuredFrom: Measured from your outline. Does this match your plot?
parcels.noPlots: You have not registered any plots yet.
parcels.overlapRejected: This overlaps {{name}} by {{pct}}%. That land is already registered — check your outline.
parcels.overlapFlagged: Slight overlap with a neighbouring plot. You can continue — it will be reviewed, not rejected.
parcels.invalidShape: The outline crosses itself. Clear it and draw again without crossing lines.

hint.tapFirst: Tap the first corner of your field
hint.two: 2 corners — one more makes a shape

field.name: Plot name
field.tenureHint: Only owners can earn carbon credits

soilCard.title: Soil Health Card
soilCard.subtitle: Copy the values printed on your card. Do not fill these in from memory.
soilCard.noSoilType: This plot has no soil type set. Soil weight is estimated from it, so carbon cannot be worked out until you add it on the plot.
soilCard.onlyOne: One reading is a starting point. A second card from a later date is what turns it into a measured gain you can be paid for.
soilCard.gain: Carbon up {{delta}}% since {{date}} — {{co2}} tCO₂e at the latest reading.
soilCard.noGain: No increase measured yet between {{from}} and {{to}}.
soilCard.assumptionNote: Soil weight and sampling depth are estimated from your soil type, not measured. They are recorded as estimates so nothing later treats them as readings.
soilCard.drawFirst: Draw a plot first, then add its card here.

assistant.title: Ask
assistant.intro: Ask about this plot. Answers come from your own readings, not general advice.
assistant.drawFirst: Draw a plot first. The assistant answers about your own field, not in general.

guard.reworded: Reworded once to remove an unsupported figure.
guard.rejected: Plain wording — the written answer used a figure not in your data, so it was rejected.
guard.noModel: Plain wording — no language model configured.

panel.noStudy: No matching study for your conditions yet
panel.staleReadings: Field readings are {{days}} days old. Tap “Update field readings” for current conditions.

suggest.credits: Can I claim carbon credits yet?

project.title: Carbon project
project.shareNote: Your share is worked out from the carbon your own plot gained, not split equally.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.nothing: Nothing needs your attention. You will be told if that changes.
